principle.only_measured.cmd: python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(open('FACTS.json', encoding='utf-8'))['facts'];bad=[k for k,v in d.items() if not (isinstance(v,dict) and str(v.get('cmd','')).strip())];print('facts_without_cmd=%d' % len(bad));sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"
principle.only_measured.note: numbers/behavior trust measurement only; every fact must carry a re-run command

principle.number_once.note: each number is produced once: documents reference it as [[key]], never hand-copied (enforced both ways)

principle.falsifiable.note: claims must be falsifiable: always-true shortcuts are swept by AST and any hit fails

principle.declared_not_globbed.note: predicates are declarations, not filenames: the execution surface reads registry --run <phase>

principle.off_is_visible.cmd: python3 -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'zreflect');import registry, criteria;gs=registry.gates()[0];p=criteria.off_reason_problems(gs);print('off_reason_ok gates=%d problems=%d' % (len(gs), len(p)));sys.exit(0 if gs and not p else 1)"
principle.off_is_visible.note: off must be distinguishable from "ran and passed"; a gate that can go off must declare why

principle.zero_language.note: zero language in the core: user-visible messages go through M(code); machine contracts are untranslatable by construction

principle.machine_rows.note: machine rows are defined in one place, machine.ROWS; the shell side has a behavior reconciler

principle.three_readmes.note: the three-language READMEs are three copies of one assertion: change one, change all three in the same batch

principle.snapshot_hygiene.note: a mutable global imported across modules is a value copy (stale snapshot): read via the module attribute instead

principle.assertion_lifecycle.note: a retracted claim must not quietly return as current state

principle.no_retired_names.note: retired names must not appear as current state; sha provenance and age are checkable

principle.open_questions_settle.note: every unresolved open question must carry a runnable settler

principle.selfcert_harness.cmd: python3 -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'zreflect');import registry;u=registry.modules()[1];print('undeclared_modules=%d' % len(u));sys.exit(1 if u else 0)"
principle.selfcert_harness.note: every gate must have a --selftest entry (written but never run = decoration)

principle.host_agnostic.cmd: python3 -c "import os,sys;w=['.'+chr(122)+chr(99)+chr(111)+chr(100)+chr(101)+'/','ZCODE_'+'PROJECT_DIR','hook'+'SpecificOutput'];bad=[(d,f) for d in ('zreflect','reflect-hooks') for r,_,fs in os.walk(d) for f in fs if f.endswith(('.py','.sh')) and any(k in open(os.path.join(r,f),encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read() for k in w)];print('host_coupled=%d' % len(bad));sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"
principle.host_agnostic.note: the suite's source recognizes no host's directory names / config formats (host wiring belongs to the consumer)
